newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor stock up amid fresh top post talk.
newsitem.headline: Accor stock up amid fresh top post talk.

text.p: Accor shares rose on the Paris stock exchange on Tuesday amid fresh press speculation about who could become the next chief executive of the group.
The stock was up 12 francs or 1.88 percent at 1147 GMT, while the CAC-40 leading share index was down 0.22 percent.
French newspapers La Tribune and Le Monde both suggested that Jean-Marc Espalioux could get the job. He is currently a deputy managing director at Compagnie Generale des Eaux.

Accor's current co-chairmen and founders Paul Dubrule and Gerard Pelisson said at the group's last annual meeting that they would change management structure and an announcement is due in the second half of this month.
Le Tribune said an internal candidate, Sven Boinet from the hotel side of the group, did not have full shareholder backing.
The group is due to presents its first-half results on October 7.
